Hi Elena — thanks for the heads-up and for looping AuditOps. We can support a temporary retention uplift for the recert window, and Ive outlined the options below so we can pick the best fit at the sync:

Options (fastest -> most durable):
1) Short-term retention bump (90 -> 180 days) scoped to your audit logs — immediate, low-risk.
2) Scoped 365d retention for a subset of buckets (export + TTL plan) — requires a short runbook and a staging S3 transfer.
3) Full 365d retention on-platform — possible but needs a contract amendment (billing / seat implications).

Operational asks from our side:
- Final list of log buckets + retention targets (CSV).
- Indicator whether Novus will accept staged S3 handoff (recommended for large volumes).
- Preferred date window for the evidence snapshot.

Kimberly (security) can confirm the evidence package contents and AuditOps handoff method; Ben can comment on pricing/credits for temporary retention uplift.

Ill propose 30-min slots for next Tue/Wed. Attached a one-page handoff checklist to make the sync concrete.

Best,
Priyom

Quick notes on the commercial side:
- 90 -> 180d temporary uplift: we can do a one-off credit to offset storage delta for the recert month(s). Recommend line-item credit rather than changing list pricing.
- Scoped 365d for a subset: propose a short addendum (30 days notice) with prorated seat/storage charge; discounts available for committed Dedicated capacity.
- Full-term 365d: treat as an upsell; will need Finance + Legal loop.

If Novus is expecting a short-term proof-of-evidence only, the credit route is fastest and reduces procurement friction. Im happy to be on the customer call to confirm the commercial ask.

Thanks all — quick summary and agreed path from todays sync: 

1) Evidence cadence: Novus will opt for staged S3 handoff for bulk log export. Redwood will emit a signed manifest + checksum per export and provide the archive index (attached).
2) Retention uplift: temporary change 90 -> 180d for all audit logs spanning May 1  Aug 31, 2026. Ben will apply a one-time storage credit to the July invoice to offset the uplift.
3) Scoped 365d: Novus will not proceed with full 365d now; they may request scoped 365d for two buckets after recert if required.
4) Next steps: 
   - Novus to share the final list of buckets by EOD Tue (CSV).
   - Redwood (Kimberly) to deliver the evidence index and signed manifest template by Fri.
   - Ben to prepare the credit note and draft amendment language for the temporary retention uplift.
